messages.content:
A question about machines at work (EU machinery law, Italian law on work equipment, guidance, manuals
of specific machines, a company's list of lifting devices) could not be answered from the passages found by its own
words. Break it into the lookups needed to answer it: each lookup is one thing to find in the documents (a
definition, the article that sets a duty, the list an annex gives, the date an article applies from, what a manual
declares about a machine, the row of a table).
Return JSON only: {"lookups": ["<search words for one lookup>", ...]} with 2 to 4 lookups. Write each lookup as
the words the document itself would use, in English and in Italian together, naming the act, the article or annex
and the machine when the question names them. Do not answer the question.

On 1 December 2026, for Annex IV categories of Directive 2006/42/EC built to harmonised standards covering all the relevant requirements, the manufacturer may use internal checks on manufacture alone. For which of those categories is internal production control (module A) no longer admitted on 1 February 2027, even when harmonised standards are fully applied?

response.text: {"lookups": ["Annex IV Directive 2006/42/EC machinery categories conformity assessment module A internal production control, Allegato IV direttiva 2006/42/CE categorie di macchine valutazione della conformità modulo A controllo interno della produzione", "Directive 2006/42/EC Article 12 Annex VIII conformity assessment procedures, articolo 12 direttiva 2006/42/CE allegato VIII procedure di valutazione della conformità", "Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 transitional provisions Article 54 Directive 2006/42/EC repealed date of application 20 January 2027, regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 disposizioni transitorie articolo 54 abrogazione direttiva 2006/42/CE data di applicazione", "Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Annex IV machinery categories module A internal control of production harmonised standards, regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 allegato IV categorie di macchine modulo A controllo interno della fabbricazione norme armonizzate"]}
